text:
The planned Dunmarrow canal tunnel will run 11 kilometres, the Dunmarrow Waterways Authority confirmed on 14 March 2031, when the project's final route was approved.

The tunnel is budgeted at 2.4 billion Verrian marks, with boring expected to take six years. Details appear in the Dunmarrow Canal Tunnel Feasibility and Route Report (Report DWA-31/07), which was presented to the Harlow Basin Regional Council.

Marisol Treadgold, Chief Engineer of the Authority, said the confirmed route settles the most difficult question facing the scheme. "With the alignment fixed, we can move from studying the tunnel to preparing to build it," she said.

The report sets out the route, the cost and the construction timetable for the tunnel, which would form a key link in the Dunmarrow canal network.
